n02731b5bd3.headline: Iraq says still set on expanding oil output to gain market share
n02731b5bd3.summary: Iraq intends to continue increasing oil production to expand market share while supporting OPEC efforts to stabilize prices.
n02731b5bd3.why: Iraq is a major OPEC oil producer whose production decisions influence global oil supply and prices, affecting energy markets and economies worldwide.
n02731b5bd3.why_moved: Iraq's commitment to raise oil output increases supply expectations, pressuring oil prices and impacting energy markets globally.
